fullContentHtml:
UPSC CAPF AC Name Wise Result 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the Name Wise result for the Combined Central Armed Police Force CAPF Examination 2026. This recruitment was released for 349 posts. Applications for the UPSC CAPF AC Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 20 February 2026, to 12 March 2026. The written examination was conducted on 19 July 2026. Candidates who had appeared in this Examination can download their UPSC CAPF AC Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 20 February 2026
  • Last Date : 12 March 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 12 March 2026
  • Exam Date : 19 July 2026
  • Admit Card : 10 July 2026
  • Answer Key : 22 July 2026
  • Result : 25 August 2026
  • Name Wise Result : 08 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC : Rs. 200/-
  • SC, ST : 0/-
  • All Category Female : 0/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.

UPSC CAPF AC Name Wise Result 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

The last date to apply is 12 March 2026.

The official website is: https://upsc.gov.in/whats-new

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
